integrity: Original full polytope vertex data and exact facet/perturbation computation are reproduced in RESULT.md and verify.py; no claim of independent verification or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Exactly four is an equivariant classification of projective small resolutions over a fixed target; no classification of non-toric small resolutions or of abstract isomorphism classes is claimed. The source assigns math.AG as its primary arXiv category without listing an MSC; 14M25 is the direct MSC2020 subject for this toric birational geometry.
title: Four projective crepant small resolutions of the 4-crown Richardson threefold
